q: The Furstenberg-Poisson boundary of a random walk (Γ,μ) on a group Γ is the unique μ-stationary measure space (B,ν) to which the random walk converges. For lattices in semisimple Lie groups, the Poisson boundary is:
opts: The Furstenberg boundary G/P (P = minimal parabolic subgroup)
exp: Furstenberg showed that for a lattice Γ ≤ G in a semisimple Lie group, with appropriate measure μ on Γ, the Poisson boundary is G/P (the Furstenberg boundary = real flag variety). This boundary characterises the 'ideal boundary' of the random walk and is the key tool in Margulis's proof of superrigidity.
